title: warmly spiced portuguese chicken braise
description: A richly flavored and juicy chicken braise from Portugal, featuring allspice berries and a hint of sweetness.
instructions: Preheat your binchotan grill to medium-high heat.
Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large grill-safe pot over medium-high heat.
Sear the chicken until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pot and set aside.
Reduce the heat to medium and add the onions to the pot.
Cook the onions until they are caramelized, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, oregano, cinnamon, and allspice to the pot.
Add the red wine and chicken broth to the pot, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Return the chicken to the pot and bring the liquid to a simmer.
Transfer the pot to the binchotan grill and cook for 30 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Strain the juices and serve the chicken with the sauce spooned over the top.
